description: Phase 5+6: Grafana Alloy migration (replace Promtail) and Loki/Alertmanager rules cleanup. Replace the deprecated Promtail service with Grafana Alloy for log collection. Fix all alert rules to use stable {service=...} selectors instead of brittle {container="dev-*"} patterns. Fix Alertmanager inhibition rule referencing nonexistent ServiceDown alert.
steps: Create `docker/monitoring/alloy.alloy` configuration file: (a) Use `loki.source.docker` component to discover Docker containers via socket. (b) Extract compose labels: com.docker.compose.service -> service, com.docker.compose.project -> compose_project. (c) Add static labels: environment='development', stack='rag-dev'. (d) Forward to loki.write endpoint at http://loki:3100/loki/api/v1/push. (e) Include pipeline stages for JSON parsing (matching the existing promtail.yaml logic) and rate limiting.

In `compose.yml`, replace the `promtail` service with `alloy`: image `grafana/alloy:v1.9.1`, profile 'obs', mount docker/monitoring/alloy.alloy as config, mount /var/run/docker.sock and /var/lib/docker/containers read-only, depends_on loki healthy, healthcheck on port 12345 (Alloy default HTTP port), similar resource limits.
In `compose.dev.yml`, remove any promtail port mapping and add alloy port if needed (12345 for Alloy UI).
Update ALL alert rules in `docker/monitoring/rules/telegram-bot.yaml` to replace `{container="dev-bot"}` with `{service="bot"}`. This applies to every alert expr in the file.

Update ALL alert rules in `docker/monitoring/rules/infrastructure.yaml` to replace `{container="dev-qdrant"}` with `{service="qdrant"}`, `{container="dev-redis"}` with `{service="redis"}`, `{container="dev-litellm"}` with `{service="litellm"}`, `{container=~"dev-langfuse.*"}` with `{service=~"langfuse.*"}`, `{container="dev-bge-m3"}` with `{service="bge-m3"}`, `{container="dev-bm42"}` with `{service="bm42"}`, `{container=~"dev-bge-m3|dev-bm42|dev-user-base"}` with `{service=~"bge-m3|bm42|user-base"}`, `{container="dev-postgres"}` with `{service="postgres"}`, `{container="dev-clickhouse"}` with `{service="clickhouse"}`, `{container="dev-langfuse"}` with `{service="langfuse"}`, `{container="dev-langfuse-worker"}` with `{service="langfuse-worker"}`.

Update ALL alert rules in `docker/monitoring/rules/extended-services.yaml` to replace container-based selectors: `{container="dev-docling"}` -> `{service="docling"}`, `{container="dev-minio"}` -> `{service="minio"}`, `{container="dev-redis-langfuse"}` -> `{service="redis-langfuse"}`, `{container="dev-lightrag"}` -> `{service="lightrag"}`.
Update ALL alert rules in `docker/monitoring/rules/ingestion.yaml` to replace `{container="dev-ingestion"}` with `{service="ingestion"}`.

In `docker/monitoring/alertmanager.yaml`, fix the inhibition rule: replace `source_match: alertname: ServiceDown` with a reference to actual existing critical alerts (e.g. use `source_matchers: ['severity="critical"']` and `target_matchers: ['severity="warning"']` pattern, or remove the broken ServiceDown inhibit rule and keep only the severity-based one).
Update `docker/monitoring/promtail.yaml` header comment to note it is DEPRECATED and Alloy is the replacement. Keep the file for short-lived backward compatibility but add clear deprecation notice.
Update `docker/monitoring/README.md` to document the Alloy migration: note Promtail is deprecated/EOL, Alloy is the new collector, explain the stable label selectors in alert rules.

Write tests in `tests/unit/observability/test_alert_rules_selectors.py`: (a) Parse all YAML files in docker/monitoring/rules/ and assert no expr contains 'container="dev-' pattern. (b) Assert all alert exprs use {service=...} or {service=~...} selectors.

Write test in `tests/unit/observability/test_alloy_config.py`: (a) Assert docker/monitoring/alloy.alloy file exists. (b) Assert it contains 'loki.source.docker' or 'discovery.docker' component. (c) Assert it references the loki endpoint.
acceptance_criteria: docker/monitoring/alloy.alloy exists with Docker log collection config
compose.yml has 'alloy' service under obs profile replacing promtail as the active collector
promtail service is either removed from compose.yml or kept as deprecated alongside alloy
All alert rules in docker/monitoring/rules/ use {service=...} selectors, zero {container="dev-*"} patterns
Alertmanager inhibition rule no longer references nonexistent ServiceDown alert
verification: Run `uv run pytest tests/unit/observability/test_alert_rules_selectors.py tests/unit/observability/test_alloy_config.py -v` and confirm pass
Run `make test-unit` and confirm full unit suite green
Run `docker compose --env-file tests/fixtures/compose.ci.env -f compose.yml -f compose.dev.yml config --quiet` and confirm exit 0
